text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Monday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The 33rd Organisation of African Unity assembly of heads of state and government opens in Harare on Monday. High on the agenda will be conflicts in Africa, the dispute between Libya and the United States, and the Middle East conflict.
- At least 27 heads of state and government and prime ministers had arrived by early Sunday night for the 33rd OAU summit which begins in Harare on Monday.
